title: Where to Eat Near Museum Island - Quick Summary
items: **Your exit decides the direction.** From the Bode-Museum, Hackescher Markt and Georgenstraße are closest; from the Altes Museum, the Humboldt Forum and the Nikolaiviertel are.
**On the island:** every museum has a small café, and **Cu29** in the James-Simon-Galerie (Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00) needs no museum ticket.
**Mondays:** the island museums and their cafés are closed. The **Lebenswelten Bistro** in the Humboldt Forum is open every day and free to enter.
**Tuesdays:** the Humboldt Forum exhibitions and its rooftop **Restaurant Baret** are closed, while the island is open.
**West:** **Deponie Nr. 3** in the Georgenstraße railway arches, open daily from 10:00, about five minutes from the Bode-Museum. German debit card or cash, no credit cards.
**East and north:** **Brauhaus Georgbräu** on the Spree (daily from 12:00) and the beer halls at **Hackescher Markt**, Weihenstephaner and Das Lemke.
**My move:** pick the museum you leave, the day and your break in the map below, then choose your second museum by where you ate.
